svg.title: Career shown as a five-stage CPU pipeline
svg.desc: Fetch: BTech at MPUAT and PG Diploma at CDAC-ACTS, 2013 to 2018. Decode: Project Engineer at CDAC, 2018 to 2020. Execute: Senior Engineer at Ceremorphic, 2020 to 2024. Access: Senior Engineer at MIPS, 2024. Commit: Staff Engineer at Ventana Micro Systems, acquired by Qualcomm, 2024 to now.
